item.description:

item.title: LA's October openings, from Spacca Tutto in the Palisades to Bar Fortuna in Santa Monica
item.description:
October's biggest LA opening was Spacca Tutto, Nancy Silverton's Italian-American steakhouse in Palisades Village, open since Oct. 15, per LA Today. Fine Dining Lovers notes it is her first restaurant west of the 405 and part of an area still recovering from the 2025 fires.

item.title: LA County ordered 35 food businesses closed Oct. 8–23, mostly for vermin
item.description:
Los Angeles County health inspectors ordered 35 restaurants, markets and other food businesses to close between Oct. 8 and Oct. 23, Food World News reported. Vermin was cited in 31 of them.

item.title: The Stand opens at the renamed Valley mall in Mission Valley
item.description: The former Mission Valley Mall has been fully remodeled and renamed the Valley, and new tenants are arriving. The Stand, a casual American-classics restaurant, celebrated its grand opening there on Oct. 8, Times of San Diego reports. It's the brand's 23rd location and its third in San Diego.

item.title: Vallejo council backs a stronger affordable-housing requirement for new developments
item.description:
On Tuesday, the Vallejo City Council voted 5–1 for an inclusionary housing ordinance that requires new residential projects to include a share of affordable units, the Vallejo Sun reports. The council chose the Planning Commission's stronger version over a scaled-down staff recommendation.

item.title: Downtown Sacramento Ice Rink returns Nov. 4 with $2 opening-day skating
item.description:
The Downtown Sacramento Ice Rink at Ali Youssefi Square (Seventh and K) opens its 34th season on Wednesday, Nov. 4, ABC10 reports. Opening-day admission is $2, and the rink is open 2–9 p.m. after a 10 a.m. ribbon cutting. The season runs through Jan. 18, 2027.

item.description:
Shio Japanese Dining celebrated its grand opening at 2259 Avenida de la Playa in La Jolla Shores, SanDiegoVille reports. The space was previously Galaxy Taco and Sandpiper Wood Fired Grill & Oysters. The group running it is connected to nearby Takaramono Sushi.

item.description:

item.description:
Jeremy Fox's Birdie G's, which closed at Santa Monica's Bergamot Station on Dec. 20, 2025, reopened on Monday, Oct. 26 at 2025 Avenue of the Stars in Century City, according to LAeats.

item.description:
Takorea, a Mexican-Korean counter spot at 3858 Piedmont Ave. in Oakland, held its grand opening on Sunday, Oct. 25, after a soft opening in late summer, according to The Bay Area Brief. It sits in the former Fuji Summer space.

item.title: Grand Park's free Downtown Día de los Muertos runs through Nov. 2
item.description:
Gloria Molina Grand Park's Downtown Día de los Muertos is a free, 10-day outdoor exhibition running Oct. 24 to Nov. 2, open 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. at 200 N Grand Ave. It's all ages and free, with no ticket needed.
This year it features 17 altars by artists and local organizations, curated by Consuelo G.

item.description:
